summary: ZipLongest polls an input again after it returns None, allowing a non-fused input to resume yielding values. The fix wraps both inputs in Fuse, preserving exhaustion independently. The regression test added in tests/zip.rs expects Right(3) for the third item; reversing the input storage and constructor changes should instead produce Both(3, 3). Both selected regions occur exactly once in their respective Git source files. No builds or tests were run.
